services.title: Respite care
services.description: Family member leaves for a break; caregiver and client complete a puzzle action.

services.title: Companionship
services.description: Deal and play cards, share a laugh, then continue the game.

services.title: Personal care
services.description: Guide forearm through a cardigan sleeve and gently adjust clothing.

services.title: Hygiene assistance
services.description: Visible hair-brushing strokes and tidy grooming, preserving dignity.

services.title: Meal preparation
services.description: Prepare ingredients, then serve actual food onto a plate.

services.title: Light housekeeping
services.description: Wipe a surface, cut to a complete forward/back vacuum pass.

services.title: Laundry assistance
services.description: Remove clean laundry, fold a shirt fully, place it on a stack.

services.title: Medication reminders
services.description: Prompt an existing routine; client opens their own English-labeled organizer and reaches for water. No dosing advice or administration.

services.title: Errand assistance
services.description: Select produce, put it in a bag, release the bag into the cart, then move together.
